title: Key visual: an abstract ink shaft over the top 70%, a scale marker stating the person-to-structure ratio, a compressed name, a tagline, one signal button and three readouts on a black floor
use: The first screen of a game site or a key visual. plate=drawn draws the abstract structure plate (no figure); plate=slot leaves an image slot for generated art.

plate.note: draw the abstract plate or leave the image slot

relations: The plate fills y 0-70%; a void floor starts at 66% with a hairline seam; every line of type stands on the floor or on the scale marker's scrim.
The name is 128 units at 900 compressed to 78% (scale 0.78 1); labels are 12 units: 10.7 : 1.
The scale marker is a 10-unit tick beside a 420-unit bracket at (900, 360) with the ratio in signal.
decoration: Structure plate (frames, screentone, seams, ribs, a beam, cables, light slit), the seam: drawn.
The kicker's rail script spells title_latin in lowercase (decoration beside the kicker).
